Overlapping_Keratinous_Scales.description: A dry, continuous layer of overlapping keratin scales. It effectively locks moisture inside the body against arid climates and turns aside glancing blows from minor physical trauma without restricting movement.

Subdermal_Osteoderm_Plating.description: Massive, bony deposits forming impenetrable armored scutes directly within the dermis layer. Highly reminiscent of crocodilian or ankylosaur armor, rendering the creature practically immune to light slashing attacks.

Chromatophore_Adaptive_Skin.description: A delicate, specialized layer of skin housing millions of pigment-containing chromatophore cells. Connected directly to the nervous system, it can actively alter the entity's color and pattern to achieve near-perfect optical invisibility against any background.
